verdict.rationale: Temporal Server is open-source and explicitly documented for self-hosting via Docker, Kubernetes, or manual deployment, with a full self-hosted guide including Web UI, and the CLI itself bundles a local dev server ('temporal server start-dev') confirmed at runtime. GitHub repo further corroborates the OSS server binary. Missing for 10: independent third-party account of running a production self-hosted cluster at scale, and clearer documentation of self-hosted feature parity vs Cloud-only features (mTLS, security add-ons appear Cloud-specific).
